# Welcome to Dartastic Hosted

Your dedicated observability stack. **OTel data ingest, deobfuscated stack traces, and Flutter-aware dashboards** — pre-configured and ready.

- [Setup guide](https://dartastic.io/help#hosted) · how to point your apps at this stack.
- [Dartastic Pub](https://pub.dartastic.io) · your private package registry.
- [Dartastic Symbolizer](https://symbolizer.dartastic.io) · obfuscated traces → source lines.
- [Support](https://dartastic.io/support) · contact the team.

## Dart + Flutter observability

This stack ships with dashboards tuned for Dart server and Flutter mobile apps. The defaults:

- **Flutter App Health** — frames, jank, ANR, vsync, native heap. Updates automatically as your apps emit OTel.
- **Crashes — Symbolized** — production stack traces deobfuscated to source lines via the Dartastic Symbolizer.
- **Service Map** — your Dart server topology from OTLP spans.

### Send data

Point your OTel exporter at your stack's OTLP endpoint (gRPC 4317 + HTTP 4318):

```
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otlp.<your-stack>.dartastic.io
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS=authorization=Bearer <otel-ingest-key>
```

Mint an **otel-ingest** key on the [Hosted tab](https://dartastic.io/dashboard?tab=hosted) at dartastic.io.
